edmx.xsd and edm.xsd in this directory are OASIS Open's, not this project's.

They are the two XML schemas published alongside

  OData Common Schema Definition Language (CSDL) XML Representation
  Version 4.01, OASIS Standard, 11 May 2020

and are kept here byte-for-byte as OASIS published them, so each one still
carries, in its own leading comment, the notice OASIS put there:

  Copyright (c) OASIS Open 2020. All Rights Reserved.
  Source: https://docs.oasis-open.org/odata/odata-csdl-xml/v4.01/os/schemas/
  TC IPR Statement: https://www.oasis-open.org/committees/odata/ipr.php

Nothing in them has been edited, reformatted or re-indented; `tools/check_csdl.py`
checks their SHA-256 before it uses them, and refuses to run if either has
changed. The whole point of the files is that this project did not write them.
